description:
A background Java process 'TransactionProcessor' is running on localhost port 5005 with JDWP debugging enabled. Your task is to:

1. Open the loaded 'PaymentGateway' project.
2. Create a Remote JVM Debug configuration to attach to localhost:5005.
3. Set a breakpoint in the 'processTransaction' method.
4. Debug the process to inspect the value of the 'transactionToken' variable.
5. Save this token value into a file named 'token_found.txt' in the project root directory (/home/ga/IdeaProjects/PaymentGateway/token_found.txt).
